title: Crisp Korean Pajeon Scallion Pancake
summary: An ice-cold flour and starch batter is folded with lots of spring onion and fried as two thin pancakes, pressed flat until crisp, cut into wedges and served with a chilli-soy dip.

ingredients.item: gochugaru (Korean chilli flakes) or other chilli flakes
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the dip
steps.text: Whisk the soy, water, vinegar, sesame oil, chilli flakes and sugar.

steps.title: Prepare the onions
steps.text: Cut the spring onions into 5 cm lengths, halving the white parts.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.text: Whisk the dry ingredients with ice water and garlic, then fold in the onions.

steps.title: Fry the first side
steps.text: Spread half the batter in a hot oiled pan and cook 3-5 minutes until golden underneath.

steps.title: Flip and press
steps.text: Flip, add oil round the edge and press flat for 2-4 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve with the dip.

tips: Ice water keeps the batter light and crisp.
Use enough oil: pajeon should shallow-fry, not dry-fry.
Press the pancake flat after flipping for an even crust.
storage: Best eaten straight from the pan. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours for up to 2 days and re-crisp in a dry frying pan.
